architecture_notes: Current authority is split intentionally: apps/docs/guide/asset-system.md owns Media Asset/Resource rules, asset-generator-model.md owns native Generator semantics and product migration status, document-assets.md owns typed Document identity/versioning, and durable-run-protocol.md owns the private execution graph. Files explicitly marked historical or superseded are context only, not implementation contracts.
